From the Hearts
We've Captured

The level of intentionality in every pixel is staggering. We didn't just get a website; we got a digital monument that defines our brand's future. It is the rare intersection of pure artistry and strategic brilliance

Eloped, Donegal Coast

She has this rare ability to disappear into the background and still be everywhere at once. Looking through our gallery felt like reliving the day, not watching it from the outside, but being pulled straight back in.

item.title: ABOUT
item.dc:creator: MikulasKarpeta
item.content:encoded:
MEET YOUR ARTIST

Capturing the Soul
Behind the Lens

I am a curator of light and quiet moments. Founded on the belief that beauty is found in the stillness between breaths, I create digital heirlooms for the romantically inclined.

BASED

Brooklyn, NY

TRAVELS

Worldwide

FEATURED

Vogue, Kinfolk

My Philosophy

I believe that a wedding is more than an event; it is a tapestry of fleeting emotions, soft textures, and the profound silence of two souls connecting. My approach is rooted in an editorial aesthetic, blending the grace of film with the precision of high-end digital artistry.

Every frame I capture is treated with the reverence of a fine art painting. We don’t just take photographs; we preserve the atmosphere—the scent of damp earth, the weight of the silk, and the nervous laughter that defines your story.

item.title: PORTFOLIO
item.dc:creator: MikulasKarpeta
item.content:encoded:
PORTFOLIO

Stories of
Light & Love

A curated digital heirloom for the intentional soul. We document love not just as it looks, but as it feels—through a lens of poetic grace and editorial sophistication.

item.title: Clara & Thomas
item.dc:creator: MikulasKarpeta
item.content:encoded:
Clara & Thomas

Service: Video

Working on this project in the English countryside, I sought to blend classic British tradition with modern artisanal detail. I focused on the textures of handmade paper, the delicacy of the wedding rings, and the tangible atmosphere of history to create a digital heirloom that celebrates the enduring value of vows within a character-filled setting.

item.title: Elena & Marcus
item.dc:creator: MikulasKarpeta
item.content:encoded:
Elena & Marcus

In the heart of Provence, I embarked on a mission to document raw joy and spontaneous emotions under the open sky. My approach combines documentary authenticity with the poetic light of the French countryside.

item.title: Isabella & Julian
item.dc:creator: MikulasKarpeta
item.content:encoded:
Isabella & Julian

Service: Editorial

As a dedicated wedding photographer specializing in Lake Como’s prestigious venues, I focused on capturing the seamless harmony between luxury and the natural elements. My goal was to create a visual narrative that radiates timeless elegance and profound serenity, ensuring every frame accentuates the delicate beauty of the floral arrangements and the iconic Italian architecture.
